sections.label: ⚙️ Internal
items: Added `tests/support/filterSortAssertions.js` (`waitForFilterSettled()`, `waitForSortSettled()`, `waitForSubTableFilterSettled()`, `getPageRowCount()`, `getSubTableRowCounts()`) and four live specs (`filter-global`, `filter-column`, `filter-subtable`, `sort-column`) asserting row-count invariants across the global/column/sub-table filtering and sorting framework. Corrected the original design's settle-wait against real, variable debounce timing (see task-playwright-test-infra-expansion.md's Part 5 implementation notes) and the STF input's real selector. Test tooling only; no userscript runtime changes.

sections.label: ⚙️ Internal
items: Added `tests/support/stopButton.js` (`stopAfterPages()`) and `tests/live/stop-button-pagination.spec.js` — emulates clicking `#mb-stop-btn` partway through a paginated fetch (default: after 2 pages) and verifies the fetch loop truncates cleanly, still renders the partial data, and the button returns to hidden. Test tooling only; no userscript runtime changes.

sections.label: ⚙️ Internal
items: Added `tests/support/asyncCompletion.js` (`waitForCaaEaaComplete()`, `waitForRelationshipsComplete()`), polling `#mb-info-display-caa`/`#mb-info-display-rel` as reliable completion signals for the CAA/EAA artwork queue and the async Relationships column, instead of the transient completion toasts. Test tooling only; no userscript runtime changes.

sections.label: ⚙️ Internal
items: Added `tests/live/uniqdrop-structure-section.spec.js`, the first live Playwright spec built on WIP.1's `window.__saTest` hook — exercises the unique-values dropdown's "Structure" section (empty/single-row/collapsed/expanded cell states) against a real MusicBrainz page. Test tooling only; no userscript runtime changes.

sections.label: ⚙️ Internal
items: Added a `window.__saTest` debug hook (`getUniqDropSections()`, `closeUniqDrop()`), gated behind `window.__SA_TEST_MODE__` — a read-only introspection surface for the Playwright test harness, inert outside test runs. Adds no UI and changes no user-visible behavior.
